svg.title: L2 Services -- Web application on AWS
svg.desc: Route 53 sends web clients through AWS WAF to CloudFront and the public load balancer. Web servers call application servers through an internal load balancer, and the application servers use RDS, ElastiCache and EFS. Every tier runs in two Availability Zones.
